title: Incident review: checkout outage
text: Checkout failed for 42 minutes on Tuesday because a configuration change disabled the payment provider's fallback.

sections.title: Timeline
sections.text: The change shipped at 09:10, errors began at 09:12, and the change was reverted at 09:54.

sections.title: Detection
sections.text: An alert on checkout errors paged the on-call engineer at 09:15.

sections.title: Recovery
sections.text: Reverting the change restored checkout; queued orders were replayed by 10:20.

sections.title: Follow-ups
sections.text: Configuration changes to payments now need a second reviewer and a canary stage.
